account.name: Harbor Cart
account.sow: ASaaS Standard — monthly SAST/SCA/DAST triage, tickets, update packet. Adjacent: Wiz-shaped findings that land on the same apps, bug-bounty intake.
account.stack: Node + Angular storefront (Juice Shop analog). Customer licensed Snyk + Checkmarx One + Invicti. Delivery engineer operates the consoles. Tickets in customer Jira (guest project HARBOR).
account.jiraOwner: Customer Jira · project HARBOR · delivery can comment and transition; cannot change workflow

findings.title: Prototype pollution in lodash
findings.description: SCA: lodash merge used in order import. Tool marks function reachable from /api/orders/import.

findings.title: Prototype pollution in minimist
findings.description: DevDependency. Not imported by runtime. SCA lists it because lockfile has it.

findings.title: jsonwebtoken unrestricted key type
findings.description: New this cycle after a package bump. Login path calls jwt.verify.

findings.title: colors protestware / maintainer sabotage
findings.description: Present in August lockfile, removed in September. Not imported.

findings.title: SQL injection — product search
findings.description: User query string concatenated into SQL. Same sink Invicti proved on the live site.

findings.title: Stored XSS — product review body
findings.description: Review HTML rendered without encode. Not yet proven by DAST (auth wall on review POST).

findings.title: Hardcoded JWT secret
findings.description: Literal secret in source. Related to jsonwebtoken SCA finding.

findings.title: DOM XSS — admin debug panel
findings.description: innerHTML on a panel compiled out of production builds. Classic noise if you skip the build flag.

findings.title: Proven SQLi on /rest/products/search
findings.description: DAST error-based payload returned SQL fragment. Confirms Checkmarx sink is live.

findings.title: Missing Content-Security-Policy
findings.description: Header absent on every crawl. Hygiene, not a working exploit.

findings.title: Open redirect on /redirect?to=
findings.description: Present in August crawl. September crawl 404 — route removed. Candidate close if evidence is the 404 + code gone.

findings.title: Public S3 + env file with API key
findings.description: Toxic combo: bucket world-readable AND secret object. Adjacent to AppSec because the key signs the same API.

findings.title: Base image CVE in worker (not called by storefront)
findings.description: Critical in an offline batch image. Not on the internet path. Easy to over-rank if you ignore runtime.

findings.title: IDOR — other users' orders
findings.description: Reporter supplied two session cookies and swapped order IDs. Valid intake, not a scanner finding.

findings.title: Claimed reflected XSS on homepage
findings.description: One-line report, no payload, no screenshot. Reject / drop until evidence exists.

tickets.body: SQL injection in product search. Parameterize req.query.q. File: backend/routes/search.ts:41.
Open redirect on /redirect. Restrict to allowlist or remove route.
Remove unused colors dependency from lockfile.
